notes: Official model card says 2.8T total; 1M-context multimodal model. Weights_gib is the ideal unpruned 4-bit payload computed as total parameters × 0.5 bytes ÷ 2^30. Required memory adds 12% weight-format/scales/allocation overhead plus 56 GiB for one 108K session KV, runtime and OS (80 GiB for >1.5T models). This is an engineering estimate, not a demonstrated minimum deployment.
